preregistration.selection: Keep active fixed plan; no automatic policy promotion. A candidate must pass all vehicle gates against both current and selected fixed plans, plus pedestrian guard.
preregistration.scope: Retrospective development on existing video; seeds vary drivers, not independent mornings.
